diagnosis: The service telemetry metrics endpoint returns hourly latency percentiles, error rates, and throughput aggregated by OpenTelemetry span instrumentation for any serviceId passed in the path. It lacks authorization logic to verify that the requesting user belongs to the organization that deploys the service, enabling unauthorized parties to map internal architecture load patterns.
